papers.title: Whippets have larger abdominal caudal vena cava to aorta ratios than other dogs on computed tomography.
papers.authors: Esmieu SL, Ma MH, Mantis P, Biondo S, Constantinescu R
papers.abstract: Whippets are sighthounds with distinct cardiovascular adaptations associated with athletic performance. The caudal vena cava to aorta ratio (CVC/Ao) is an established index of intravascular volume status, assessed ultrasonographically and on computed tomography (CT) at thoracic and abdominal sites, but breed-specific differences remain unreported. papers.title: Effects of rifaximin on the fecal microbiota of healthy dogs: a pilot study.
papers.authors: Harada H, Tamura M, Kawabata M, Sakatani A, Deguchi T
papers.abstract: Rifaximin is a poorly absorbed antibiotic that is used for the treatment of hepatic encephalopathy in humans. However, it is important to evaluate the effects of antibiotics on the gut microbiota because antibiotics may alter gut microbial composition. This study aimed to investigate the effects of 28 days rifaximin administration on the gut microbiota of healthy dogs. Five healthy dogs were administered rifaximin (25 mg/kg q12h) for 28 days.
